whoAmI.main_statement: I am a full-stack software engineer dedicated to building high-performance digital products where robust logic meets seamless user experience.
whoAmI.paragraph_1: My work exists at the intersection of complex system architecture and intuitive design. I don't just write code; I architect end-to-end solutions that prioritize scalability, security, and maintainability.
whoAmI.paragraph_2: With deep roots in the JavaScript ecosystem—from optimized React interfaces to resilient Node.js/Next.js backends—I focus on creating fluid applications that feel natural and perform at scale. Every line of server logic and every millisecond of latency matters.

items.label: Backend & Systems
items.s: I build APIs and backend logic with JavaScript and Node.js, with growing TypeScript skills. I've worked with databases like Appwrite, structuring data around real application needs. I focus on writing clean, well-organized code.

items.label: Frontend & Web Vitals
items.s: I build interactive interfaces with React and Next.js, styled with Tailwind CSS and brought to life with Motion animations. I focus on smooth, responsive UI, writing components that are easy to extend and maintain.

items.label: DevOps & Technical Rigor
items.s: I use Git, GitHub Actions, and Docker in my daily workflow, keeping projects organized — from containerization to clear commit history and clean repo structure.
